jobs.title: Adult Education Instructor
jobs.description: Black River Technical College is seeking qualified applicants for the position of Adult Education Instructor located primarily on the Paragould Campus. Teaching at other locations may sometimes be required of the instructor. This position may require evening or weekend hours. The job is a full-time, twelve-month position. The College is committed to a quality work environment and experience by providing the following benefits in addition to compensation: COLA and/or bonuses are provided whenever fiscally responsible Eight hours of sick leave monthly after fulfilling all work hours in a pay period Eight hours of vacation leave monthly after fulfilling all work hours in a pay period Vacation leave increases according to years of service schedule Eight hours per calendar year of education leave A portion of health insurance premium paid by BRTC $20,000 life insurance policy with premium paid by BRTC 14% minimum retirement contribution from BRTC each pay period 11 paid State Holidays per calendar year if employed full time during the date of those Holidays Tuition Waiver for Employee and dependents to BRTC DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: The Adult Education Instructor will teach Adult Basic Education, ESL, and GED courses. Subjects taught will include but not be limited to the GED test areas (literature, writing, social studies, science, and math) and adult basic education skill areas (language, math, and reading). The instructor may also be responsible for teaching ESL (English as a Second Language) classes, Distance and Virtual Learning, Integrated Education and Training, and workplace classes. In addition, the instructor will complete any professional development needed as determined by the Adult Education Division. Other responsibilities of the instructor include: administering the TABE assessment to determine individual skills and TABE post-tests to assess progress according to recommended guidelines, administering the GED Ready pre-test and making assignments or referrals based on the results, completing and maintaining appropriate student registration, attendance, and assessment records. SPECIAL SKILLS: Knowledge and experience using MS Word, Excel, Zoom, Go Meet (or another online meeting platform), and Canvas (or other open-source learning management platforms such as Moodle or Blackboard). The candidate must have the ability to be a self-starter and work remotely with students online. QUALIFICATIONS: The applicant must have a Bachelor's degree and possess a current Arkansas Teaching Certificate. In addition, Adult Education Certification is required within three years of the hire date. Applications will be taken until the position is filled. Interested candidates should submit a cover letter, resume, state application, and three references to: BLACK RIVER TECHNICAL COLLEGE Julie Edington, Executive Director of Human Resources P.O. Box 468 Pocahontas, AR 72455 Telephone (870) 248-4032 BRTC is an Affirmative Action/Equal Opportunity Employer BRTC is a Tobacco Free Campus

jobs.title: Arkansas College of Osteopathic Medicine Announces New Dean
jobs.location: Arkansas Colleges of Health Education, AR
jobs.description: Arkansas College of Osteopathic Medicine Announces New Dean May 11, 2026 | News & Updates Christopher Loyke, DO, FACOFP Fort Smith, Arkansas — The Arkansas College of Osteopathic Medicine (ARCOM) is pleased to announce the appointment of Christopher Loyke, DO, FACOFP, as its next Dean, effective July 1, 2026. Dr. Loyke brings a wealth of experience in medical education and leadership, most recently serving as Dean and Chief Academic Officer at the DeBusk College of Osteopathic Medicine. Throughout his career, he has demonstrated a strong commitment to academic excellence, student success, and the advancement of osteopathic medical education. “We are thrilled to welcome Dr. Loyke to ARCOM,” said Teressa Brown, PT, DPT, PhD, Provost of the Arkansas Colleges of Health Education (ACHE). “His extensive leadership experience and deep understanding of osteopathic medical education make him an outstanding choice to lead ARCOM into its next chapter. We are confident that under his guidance, the college will continue to grow in excellence and impact.” As Dean, Dr. Loyke will oversee ARCOM’s academic program, faculty development, and strategic initiatives that support ARCOM’s mission to educate and train compassionate, skilled physicians who serve communities in need. Please join us in welcoming Dr. Loyke to the ARCOM and ACHE community.

jobs.title: Assistant Professor
jobs.description: Assistant Professor Bookmark this Posting Print Preview | Apply for this Job Position Details Position Information Posting Number F0512025 Working Title Assistant Professor Department Org 365000 - Mathematics Why should you work at UCA? We are excited that you are considering joining the UCA Family—the faculty, staff, students and alumni—who make the University of Central Arkansas a great place to work!At the University of Central Arkansas, we value our employees striving to maintain a work-life balance. We realize that this affects the overall well-being of employees while learning to prioritize challenging work and the ability to make a difference. Participation in university-wide flexible work schedules may be available for certain positions. Training is provided on systems or job-specific software, and tools are available supporting professional and personal development. The benefits package allows you to customize your benefits to meet your current needs, with the ability to adjust them as your priorities change. This includes university contributions to health, dental, life and disability insurance, 80% tuition waivers for employees and their families, 12 official holidays, immediate leave accrual, and a retirement program with university contributions of 10% of employee salary. Also available are health and wellness incentives, as well as access to sports and cultural activities on campus for the family, free gym membership and equipment rentals. Position Summary The Department of Mathematics at the University of Central Arkansas invites applications for a tenure-track Assistant Professor position in Mathematics starting Fall 2026. We are seeking a candidate dedicated to teaching who also demonstrates a clear potential for research and a commitment to service. This position is governed by state and federal laws and agency/institution policy. Job Duties and Responsibilities A faculty member in Mathematics typically will have 12 hours of teaching load in each Fall and Spring semester. The faculty member will be expected to teach a variety of mathematics courses as well as lower-division service courses (E.g. Calculus and Elementary Statistics). Currently, most classes are in person, but some are occasionally offered online to meet the needs of our students.Our faculty are expected to strive to improve their teaching, maintain an active research program leading to peer-reviewed publications, and be willing to involve students in their research. In addition, participation in departmental, college, and community service is an essential expectation of the role. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities In addition to possessing strong analytical skills, the successful candidate will demonstrate the ability to deliver effective instruction and assess student performance, as well as engage both undergraduate and graduate students in research. Familiarity in designing and organizing courses, interdisciplinary collaboration experience, and grant writing skills would be beneficial. Skills Considered Essential for Success -Knowledge of the organization and administration of higher education.-Knowledge of state, federal, and university rules, regulations and procedures.-Ability to work in a diverse and dynamic environment.-Ability to work collaboratively and independently with common goals as a part of a team.-Ability to make sound judgments.-Effective interpersonal communication, writing, and organizational abilities.-Civility in all interactions.-Demonstrate effective follow-up. Required Education and/or Experience The position requires a Doctorate (PhD) in Mathematics or a closely related field. Candidates with specializations in applied mathematics, data science, or statistics are strongly encouraged to apply. Preferred Education and/or Experience Prior teaching experience at the university level is preferred, including teaching assistantships, guest lectures, or teaching positions.A strong background in conducting original research focusing on applied mathematics, engineering, statistics, and/or data science is preferred, e.g. publication in a reputable journal, conference, poster presentation, etc. License(s)/Certifications (Required or Preferred) University, Campus, and Community Description Thank you for your interest in employment at the University of Central Arkansas.Founded in 1907, UCA has an enrollment of more than 10,000 students and employs over 1,300 full-time employees. The university offers more than 85 undergraduate and 59 graduate certificate and degree programs, including doctoral programs in five disciplines. UCA is proud of its tradition of teaching excellence and its contributions in research, scholarship, and creative activities. Desired start date 08/16/2026 Will this position be Onsite, Remote, or Hybrid?
